skill.name: pdb-database
skill.description: Access RCSB PDB documentation for protein and nucleic acid structures, including search methods, metadata retrieval, coordinate downloads, and batch workflows.
skill.summary: Find, retrieve, and download RCSB PDB structure data for structural biology workflows.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Most static hits are benign documentation for public RCSB APIs, markdown fences, or biological identifiers misread as reconnaissance. I confirmed the visible package installation command and one reusable file download helper as scoped risks because they can modify the local environment or filesystem. No prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or hidden malicious intent was found.

remediation.issue: Package installation guidance can modify the local Python environment.
remediation.suggestion: Ask users for confirmation, prefer a project-local virtual environment, and label the deprecated package command as legacy only.

remediation.issue: The reference download helper builds output paths from unvalidated parameters.
remediation.suggestion: Validate PDB IDs and formats, normalize output_dir, and reject path traversal before writing files.

remediation.issue: Network examples do not explicitly state the intended domain boundary.
remediation.suggestion: Document that live requests should be limited to RCSB domains and user-requested structure identifiers.

content.value_statement: Finding reliable macromolecular structure data can require multiple RCSB tools and formats. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through PDB searches, metadata retrieval, and coordinate downloads.
actual_capabilities: Explains RCSB PDB search by text, attributes, sequence similarity, and structure similarity.
Shows how to retrieve entry and polymer entity metadata with rcsb-api.
Provides examples for GraphQL queries against the RCSB Data API.
Lists direct download URLs for PDB, mmCIF, structure factor, assembly, and FASTA files.
Gives batch fetching and rate-limit guidance for multiple PDB identifiers.
Points to reference documentation for endpoints, schemas, and troubleshooting.
limitations: Requires network access to RCSB services or the rcsb-api package for live data.
Does not validate biological conclusions or replace expert structural biology review.
Example download code writes files and should be constrained to approved directories.
Depends on RCSB API availability, rate limits, and current data coverage.

use_cases.title: Screen Drug Target Structures
use_cases.description: Find structures for a target protein, compare ligand complexes, and select entries for follow-up modeling.

use_cases.title: Compare Homologous Proteins
use_cases.description: Search related sequences and structures, then compare resolution, organism, and experimental method metadata.

use_cases.title: Prepare Teaching Examples
use_cases.description: Retrieve representative PDB entries and explain their coordinate formats, assemblies, and quality metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Find Structures by Name
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the PDB database skill to find hemoglobin structures. Summarize top matches, experimental method, resolution, and organism.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Candidate Entries
prompt_templates.prompt: Search RCSB PDB for human kinase structures with ATP analog ligands. Prioritize high-resolution entries and explain selection criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Coordinate Downloads
prompt_templates.prompt: For PDB IDs 4HHB, 1MBN, and 1GZX, identify available coordinate formats and create a safe mmCIF download plan.

prompt_templates.title: Design Batch Metadata Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a workflow that queries recent cryo-EM structures, retrieves metadata, respects rate limits, and summarizes missing fields.

output_examples.input: Find hemoglobin structures suitable for an introductory structural biology lesson.
output: Recommended entries include well-known hemoglobin structures with clear experimental methods and accessible biological context.
The response explains resolution, organism, assembly choice, and which coordinate format is easiest for visualization.

output_examples.input: Compare three PDB IDs and choose one for docking preparation.
output: The comparison highlights structure title, method, resolution, ligand presence, and missing metadata.
The recommendation explains which entry is most suitable and which validation checks remain.

output_examples.input: Create a batch plan for recent cryo-EM structures.
output_examples.output: The plan groups queries, adds rate-limit delays, records metadata fields, and flags entries with incomplete information.

best_practices: Validate PDB IDs, file formats, and output directories before downloading coordinate files.
Respect RCSB rate limits by batching requests and using retry delays.
Record PDB IDs, release dates, methods, resolution filters, and file formats for reproducibility.
anti_patterns: Downloading large batches without rate limiting or a clear file organization plan.
Treating missing metadata as zero or complete data without checking the source response.
Writing downloaded structures into broad, shared, or sensitive directories.

faq.question: What database does this skill use?
faq.answer: It focuses on RCSB Protein Data Bank services and documentation for macromolecular structure data.

faq.question: Can it download coordinate files?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains PDB, mmCIF, assembly, structure factor, and FASTA download options.

faq.question: Does it require internet access?
faq.answer: Live searches and downloads require network access to RCSB services or the rcsb-api package.

faq.question: Can it analyze structures directly?
faq.answer: It gives guidance for retrieving data and using structural biology tools, but it does not perform expert validation.

faq.question: Is it useful for drug discovery?
faq.answer: Yes. It can help locate target structures, ligand complexes, and metadata for modeling preparation.

faq.question: How should file downloads be handled?
faq.answer: Use approved project directories, validate identifiers, and avoid overwriting existing files without confirmation.
